relationship: Spinner outcomes accumulate into relative frequency, which can be compared with a fair probability before using a justified probability for expected frequency.

learnerLoop.action: Run spins, inspect the running frequency, judge the evidence and forecast prizes.
learnerLoop.modelChange: Outcome bins, relative-frequency trace and forecast inputs update.
learnerLoop.evidence: The sample trace, fair reference and checked expected-frequency work show what the data supports.
learnerLoop.nextDecision: Collect more evidence, revise the bias judgment or calculate the stock forecast.

invariants: Relative frequency is prize outcomes divided by total spins.
A small sample alone does not prove bias.
safeAdaptations: Vary reproducible spinner outcomes and sample sizes.
Adjust prompts while retaining a fair reference and evidence-based bias judgment.
nonGoals: Claiming causation or certainty from a short random run.

task.description: Current fair/bias audit prompt and fixed progress through the evidence phases.

model.description: Spinner outcomes, bins, relative-frequency plot and stock forecast are rendered from the scripted sequences.
model.visibility: Present throughout; forecast layers become relevant in the forecast phases.

working.description: Phase-specific prediction, fair-versus-booth comparison and expected-frequency entries.
working.visibility: A persistent sidebar card shows the current prediction, decision or calculation.

evidence.description: Counts, relative frequencies, sample-size comparison and forecast check record what the data supports.
evidence.visibility: Relevant evidence is shown as each scripted phase is completed.

completion.description: Complete phase with actual future result after the checked forecast.
completion.visibility: The persistent phase card shows completion only after the future event is run; the duplicate canvas footer is hidden.

controls.description: Phase actions, prediction/forecast inputs and reset.
controls.visibility: Action buttons and inputs are generated for the active phase.

test-context.description: Persistent claim, evidence criterion and mechanism status above the model. Changes to the audit finding and expected-count forecast without revealing bias early.
test-context.visibility: Visible throughout the investigation; statement follows the current test and forecast sample size.

spinner-identity.description: Circular blue fair reference changes to an octagonal violet booth casing. Both retain four equal sectors, with a star for prize and circles for other; fixed labels below the rotating wheel explain the symbols. The casing identifies the device, not its probability.
spinner-identity.visibility: Reference during fair trials; booth during audit and forecast. Hidden probability is revealed only after the bias judgment.

spin-counts.description: Prize outcomes and total spins for each fair or booth sample.
spin-counts.domain: Whole-number counts and prize/total relative frequency.
spin-counts.source: Scripted fairSequence and biasSequence are run by phase actions.

fair-reference.description: The stated fair spinner probability used to interpret the samples.
fair-reference.source: Fair claim in the phase content.
fair-reference.output: Fair reference and comparison work in #comparisonWork.

predicted-frequency.description: Learner prediction of relative frequency before the short or large fair run.

expected-prize-count.description: Expected prize count for a selected future number of spins.
expected-prize-count.domain: Expected count, calculated as 0.4 × n in the forecast phase.

future-outcome.description: Actual prize count in the future event used to compare with the expected count.
future-outcome.domain: Whole-number prize count over the selected future sample.

modes.audit: The source has a fixed phase sequence: predict a small fair sample, run 12, run 200 fair trials, test a 20-spin booth sample, collect 200 booth spins, judge bias, then forecast and run a future event.
modes.prediction: Prediction sliders are supplied in the short/large sample phases; an incorrect early claim gives feedback and does not advance the audit.
modes.forecast: The future sample slider and expected-count input are supplied only in forecast phases; the expected answer must match the source's rounded 0.4 × n check.
modes.support: No None/Some/All or learner-selected support mode exists in this source; phase actions are the available working controls.

dependencies: The short fair sample must be marked not enough evidence; claiming it proves bias only produces feedback.
The 20-spin booth sample must be followed by collecting 200 spins; at 200, only the biased judgement advances.
Forecast check must pass before the future event can run; the counterexample route changes n and reruns the forecast.
The source uses fixed scripted sequences, so phase counts and outcomes are deterministic at this revision.
implementation.completion: The source enters phase complete only after the checked expected-frequency forecast and runFuture action; the final actual count and forecast evidence remain visible in the complete phase.
limitations: The sample outcomes are scripted sequences rather than runtime random trials.
Phase controls and their IDs are generated inside #phaseModal, so later prediction and forecast selectors are state-dependent.
